[*] Fixed a UI issue that would cause the UI to behave in unexpected ways when the ESC KEY was pressed while opening card packs.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the game to sporadically shut down suddenly when giving other players Likes or Hiding them from the player list panel.
[*] Fixed the issue of daily tasks automatically refreshing on their own.
[*] Fixed the issue where the lobby background music would continue when opening card packs, causing two tracks to overlap.
[*] Fixed an issue prompting players using the Windows 7 operating system to update the game.
[*] Adjustments have been made to background music volume. Sex & ambient sounds generated by other players will be played at reduced volume.  We will further optimize the sound effects in future patches.
[*] Character customization should now correctly synchronize with other players in the lobby and all players' avatar will be displayed in their current dressing state. Please note this fix is experimental and will be continually improved upon.
[*] [b]Arguments[/b] have been renamed to [b]Insights[/b] to prevent terminology confusion.
[*] Fixed in-game Discord link.
[/olist]

notes.title: Stable Version 0.4.1 is Live
notes.content:
Greetings, Researchers!

After a day of testing on the alpha branch, hot patch 0.4.0a should be able to resolve most of the login issues caused by lack of server resources and is hereby released as Stable Version 0.4.1. The team will continue to monitor the update closely and address bugs and issues in the coming days.

In the original beta plan, given the limited number of beta keys initially greenlit by Steam, not every single supporter would have been able to secure a position in the closed beta, hence we were unprepared in the back end for thousands of additional players all attempting to jump online at the same time. We apologize for wasting your valuable time.

You will find in your in-game mailbox an additional booster pack as a token of thanks for your patience.

Sincerely,
Project Helius

notes.title: Closed Beta Test is Now Live
notes.content:
Greetings Researchers,

The closed beta test Build has been successfully deployed. Please note that for overall stability we allowed some known minor issues to exist in the current build and disabled some features. Expect a massive amount of issues - well, that is what tests are for.

Make sure that you have installed the update before launching the game. Welcome to submit your suggestion or bug report on our discord server.

Regards,
Project Helius
